claim_text: RNZ says it is investigating what it understands at this stage to be a cyber breach
summary: An RNZ spokesperson said on Nov 25 that it is "investigating what we understand at this stage to be a cyber breach". Its technical teams found unusual activity in one of its systems and moved at once to contain it.
detail: RNZ has not said publicly what the unusual activity was or whether any data was taken.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: 1News and The Spinoff both quote the spokesperson: "what we understand at this stage to be a cyber breach" and "identified unusual activity in one of our systems"; RNZ's Checkpoint reports the same.

claim_text: RNZ staff lost access to wi-fi, editorial systems and the VPN on Nov 25
summary: On the morning of Wednesday Nov 25, RNZ staff could not reach the wi-fi, editorial systems or the virtual private network.
detail: The Spinoff reports that an email to staff shortly after 10am said the problems came from work to fix what was understood to be a cyber breach.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: 1News: staff reported being unable to access wi-fi, editorial systems and the virtual private network on Wednesday morning; The Spinoff: staff "could not reach wi-fi, editorial systems or the virtual private network".

claim_text: RNZ's own programme said the apparent attack cut access to some editorial systems and online services
summary: RNZ's Checkpoint programme said on Nov 25 that the apparent cyber attack cut access to some editorial systems and online services.
detail: Neither RNZ nor the outlets say which online services or whether radio broadcasts were affected.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: RNZ Checkpoint summary (Nov 25, 4:45 pm): RNZ hit by "an apparent cyber attack that cut access to some editorial systems and online services".

claim_text: RNZ notified the National Cyber Security Centre
summary: RNZ says it notified the relevant authorities, including New Zealand's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC).
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: 1News: relevant authorities were notified including the National Cyber Security Centre; The Spinoff: RNZ notified the NCSC.

claim_text: The minister was informed; the NCSC will not comment
summary: According to The Spinoff, the minister responsible for both the NCSC and RNZ was told under the "no surprises" convention. The NCSC said incidents reported to it are treated as commercial in confidence and did not comment further.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The Spinoff: the minister "was informed under the no surprises convention"; the NCSC said "incidents reported to it are treated as commercial in confidence".

claim_text: RNZ is still working to resolve the effects on its systems
summary: RNZ's spokesperson said it is "now working to resolve the remaining impacts, including issues affecting our systems". RNZ has not said publicly that its systems are back to normal.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: 1News and The Spinoff both quote: "We are now working to resolve the remaining impacts, including issues affecting our systems."
notes: Re-check for an RNZ statement that systems are restored.

claim_text: Nobody has said who was behind it, or whether it is linked to the Allied Media attack
summary: No attacker has been named. The Spinoff reports that it is not yet clear how far the RNZ breach extends, or whether it is connected to the attack on the newspaper publisher Allied Media the day before.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The Spinoff (Nov 26): "It is not yet clear how far the RNZ breach extends, or whether the two attacks are connected"; no attacker is named in either report.

claim_text: Allied Media's newspapers were disrupted by an attack on Nov 24
summary: An attack early on Tuesday Nov 24 disrupted the production servers of Allied Media, publisher of the Otago Daily Times. The ODT was laid out by hand; the Greymouth Star and Hokitika Guardian could not publish for two days.
detail: The Spinoff reports the ODT printed 20 pages instead of its usual 36.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: 1News: the attack disrupted Allied Media's "production critical servers" and the ODT was laid out by hand; The Spinoff: attack "in the early hours of Tuesday", Greymouth Star and Hokitika Guardian did not publish for two days.

claim_text: Allied Media says it has found no evidence customer or staff information was accessed
summary: Allied Media's chief executive said the company has found no evidence that customer or staff information was accessed, and that restoring its systems will take some time.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: 1News: the company has found no evidence customer or staff information was accessed; "This has to be done carefully, so it will take some time before we are back to normal."

claim_text: RNZ is New Zealand's public service broadcaster
summary: RNZ (Radio New Zealand) is New Zealand's independent public service multimedia organisation, a Crown entity set up under the Radio New Zealand Act 1995.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: RNZ's about page: "New Zealand's independent public service multimedia organisation and is a Crown entity established under the Radio New Zealand Act 1995".
